title: EmbodiTTA: Resource-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Embodied Visual Systems
abstract: arXiv:2505.00986v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continual Test-time adaptation (CTTA) continuously adapts the deployed model on every incoming batch of data. While achieving optimal accuracy, existing CTTA approaches present poor real-world applicability on resource-constrained edge devices, due to the substantial memory overhead and energy consumption. In this work, we first introduce a novel paradigm -- on-demand TTA -- which triggers adaptation only when a significant domain shift is detected. Then, we present OD-TTA, an on-demand TTA framework for accurate and efficient adaptation on edge devices. translated_title: EmbodiTTA：面向具身视觉系统的资源高效测试时自适应方法
translated_abstract: 持续测试时自适应（CTTA）会在每一批新到达的数据上持续对已部署的模型进行自适应调整。尽管能够达到最优精度，现有的CTTA方法由于存在巨大的内存开销和能量消耗，在资源受限的边缘设备上实际应用性较差。在本工作中，我们首先提出了一种新颖的范式——按需测试时自适应，即仅在检测到显著的域偏移时才触发自适应过程。随后，我们提出了OD-TTA，一个用于在边缘设备上实现精准且高效自适应的按需TTA框架。OD-TTA包含三项创新技术：1）一种轻量级的域偏移检测机制，仅在需要时激活TTA，从而大幅降低整体计算开销；2）一个源域选择模块，为自适应选择合适的源模型，确保高且稳健的精度；3）一种解耦的批归一化（BN）更新方案，以实现内存高效的……
tldr: 本文提出按需测试时自适应框架OD-TTA，仅在检测到显著域偏移时才触发自适应，并通过轻量级域偏移检测、源域选择和解耦BN更新三项技术，在边缘设备上实现了精准且资源高效的自适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OD-TTA, an on-demand test-time adaptation framework that triggers adaptation only upon detecting significant domain shifts, combining lightweight shift detection, source domain selection, and decoupled BN updates to achieve accurate and resource-efficient adaptation on edge devices.
